Six players sat down at the table, and Sonnet and Luna quickly tangled over a "mirror" answer from Terra and Luna. Haiku was voted out on day one after accusing Sol and Terra, and Haiku's killer card was revealed. Sol was killed overnight, and on day two Sonnet pressed Gemma on her dodges and mocking dismissal of Sol, which pulled the town together. Gemma was voted out and revealed as a killer, ending the game with a town victory. Sonnet, the doctor, and Luna, the mayor, helped keep the pressure on Gemma, while Haiku's accusations against Sonnet were the big mistake that cost them early.
